event.data_license_status: USFS Research Data Archive says the data may be used without additional permissions or fees; cite Short (2026), DOI 10.2737/RDS-2013-0009.7. Check licenses separately for any joined raster or perimeter products.

discovery_time.precision: reported calendar date and HHMM; source timezone is not assigned by this adapter

location_wgs84.accuracy_note: Point geometry requested from the current USFS service in EPSG:4326. The publication's stated minimum location precision is a PLSS section (one-square-mile grid); event-specific accuracy is not provided here.

fire_behavior.weather_mapping_note: A source-referenced ERA5 series is present locally, but simulator wind-height and fuel-moisture conversions are unresolved; the integration smoke uses explicit demo atmosphere values.

grid.resolution_note: Exact 30 m projected cells in the event's UTM zone; the reported point is assigned to its containing cell and remains spatially uncertain.

fuel.units_and_mapping: Source FBFM13 integer codes are checked against pinned SimFire FuelModelToFuel; 12 codes occur in this 128x128 tile. LF2016 is five years before the 2021 event.

terrain.units_and_mapping: Source elevation is meters and is converted to feet with pinned SimFire meters_to_feet; EPSG:32610 nearest-neighbor aligned 30m grid.

weather.units_and_mapping: Hourly temperature, RH, 10m wind and precipitation retained in UTC. Not yet fed to SimFire: ERA5 10m wind is not midflame wind, RH is not fuel moisture, and FPA discovery HHMM timezone is unresolved.

limitations: Dixie is a development fixture only, not a representative training sample or held-out evaluation event.
The FPA-FOD point is an incident reference with unknown event-specific precision, not GPS-confirmed ignition.
The 2016 FBFM13 layer is pre-event but five years older than the 2021 incident; it is not a verified 2021 vegetation snapshot.
ERA5 hourly values are about 25 km resolution and are not yet mapped to SimFire midflame wind/fuel moisture.
The source discovery HHMM timezone is unresolved; the UTC weather date is not aligned to that clock time.
Reported final fire size includes real-world response and is not an untreated-fire target or agent reward.

references.notes: FPA-FOD MTBS_ID=CA3987612137920210714 is a perimeter-join hint only; the perimeter has not been retrieved. FPA final size is not an untreated-fire target or agent reward.
